_about: Player notes the data can't show, keyed by ESPN player id or full name: {"contract_year": true|false, "note": "short storyline"}. Kept up to date by the daily analyst task. contract_year feeds the measured 'Contract year' effect; notes are shown on player pages.

Tyler Herro.note: Tribute night in Miami on Nov 18; first meeting with Bam Adebayo since their July confrontation; benched for much of the second half vs Atlanta.

Brice Sensabaugh.note: 40 points off the bench to snap Utah's 12-game losing streak.

Michael Porter Jr..note: Expiring deal; reportedly wants about $40M a year, and Brooklyn are expected to shop him before the deadline.

Giannis Antetokounmpo.note: Faces Milwaukee for the first time on Nov 18: 'Emotions are for movies.'

Jaylen Brown.note: Left hamstring strain; misses Nov 18 at Orlando, re-evaluated before Saturday.

Kyle Kuzma.note: On an expiring deal; Milwaukee have been trying to trade him since the offseason.

Brandon Ingram.note: Could make his season debut at San Antonio after heel surgery.

Darryn Peterson.note: Five straight 20-point games for the 1-12 Jazz.

Ja Morant.note: Out with a hamstring strain he picked up against former team Memphis; coach says he may return sooner than four weeks.

Anthony Davis.note: Ripped Wizards' defense after a 44-point return; team reportedly wants 20-30 games before deciding on an extension.

Domantas Sabonis.note: Reported to want out of Sacramento; Charlotte and Toronto expected to pursue him.

Darius Acuff Jr..note: Rookie scoring about 26 a game; openly frustrated at 1-10: "I'm not a loser, so it's not fun."

Noah Clowney.note: Started for the absent Michael Porter Jr.; headed to restricted free agency, has struggled with a bench role.

Kevin Durant.note: Faces former team Golden State; within about 900 points of passing Kobe for 4th all-time; taking a career-low 12.3 shots a game.

Kristaps Porzingis.note: Stepped away for his health; Warriors withholding salary and trying to trade him.

Victor Wembanyama.note: 32 points as the Spurs won a 10th straight, rallying from 22 down in Chicago.

Trae Young.note: First scoreless game of his career in a 147-119 loss to Houston; questions about his Washington future are growing.

Paul George.note: Scored 36 against his former team, Philadelphia, in a 22-point win.

Karl-Anthony Towns.note: Faces former team Minnesota on Nov 19; extension talks reportedly stalled.

Kyrie Irving.note: Scored 34 in a warm return to Cleveland; a rest risk on second nights of back-to-backs.

Anthony Edwards.note: Out up to two months after knee surgery; the absence threatens the 65-game mark that matters for his supermax eligibility.

Jordan Poole.note: Says he hopes to return to Golden State when his contract runs out after this season.

Grayson Allen.note: Shooting about 47% from three for Charlotte; faces Phoenix for the first time since the June trade.

Royce O'Neale.note: Faces Phoenix for the first time since the June trade that sent Miles Bridges to the Suns.

Miles Bridges.note: Faces Charlotte, his longtime team, for the first time since the June trade.

Kawhi Leonard.note: Sat both Knicks games for knee management.

RJ Barrett.note: Final year of his deal; faces former team New York in a back-to-back set.

Stephen Curry.note: Oblique tear; out at least two weeks and Golden State are preparing for about a month.

Marcus Smart.note: Three-game suspension for punching Charles Bassey; eligible again after Nov 16.

James Harden.note: Broke a scoring slump with a season-high 32 at the Knicks.

Franz Wagner.note: 71 points over two road wins for Orlando's first winning streak, with Banchero out.

Ayo Dosunmu.note: Starting for Minnesota with Edwards out; faces his former team Chicago for the first time on Nov 14.

Cooper Flagg.note: First game in Boston, the team he grew up supporting in Maine; tweaked an ankle on Nov 12.

Caleb Wilson.note: Fractured right hand; surgery expected, out about four to six weeks.

Cade Cunningham.note: 27 points as Detroit ended San Antonio's 12-game winning streak.

Zion Williamson.note: Called the Pelicans' back-to-back blowouts "unacceptable" and told teammates and coaches to look in the mirror.

Ty Jerome.note: Right hip impingement; misses a third straight game Nov 18 at former team Cleveland.

Evan Mobley.note: Sprained right big toe; out at least another 7-10 days (from Nov 16).

Dejounte Murray.note: Requested a trade via Klutch; ruled out Nov 18 with an ankle sprain.

Mikal Bridges.note: Deep shooting slump with the Knicks; Brunson publicly backed him.

Jalen Green.note: Named in Suns trade talk around Dejounte Murray; averaging a career-low 11.8 points.

Santi Aldama.note: Back from knee surgery; minutes limit lifted, calls it an "in-season training camp".

Lauri Markkanen.note: Out at least a month with a non-displaced fracture in his right hand.

Nique Clifford.note: Traded from Sacramento to Oklahoma City on Nov 8; first meeting with his former team.

Gary Trent Jr..note: The NBA is investigating whether his Milwaukee deal circumvents the salary cap.

GG Jackson.note: Broken fifth metatarsal in his left foot; needs surgery, no timeline, in his contract year.

Nikola Vucevic.note: Back in Orlando on a one-year deal; faces former team Boston on Nov 16.

Bradley Beal.note: Repeated setbacks with his hip; Tyronn Lue doubts a near-term return.

Jalen Johnson.note: Milwaukee-area native; Atlanta kept him rather than trade for Giannis.

Scottie Barnes.note: Upgraded to questionable after missing four games with a groin strain.

Fred VanVleet.note: Back from a torn ACL and starting: 'I'm appreciating every minute.'

Damian Lillard.note: Back from a long Achilles rehab; faces Milwaukee, where he got hurt, on Nov 19.

Tyrese Haliburton.note: Hamstring timetable "uncertain" per Carlisle; Pacers shopping for upgrades meanwhile.

Kon Knueppel.note: Re-strained his hamstring in his season debut; about four weeks out.

Donovan Mitchell.note: Rested a bruised knee on Nov 14; removed from the injury report for the Bulls game.

Joel Embiid.note: Sat vs Indiana with plantar fascia management; hasn't played both ends of a back-to-back this season.

Paolo Banchero.note: Out since Oct 23 with a high ankle sprain.

Austin Reaves.note: Heel bruise; will try to play Nov 18 vs Utah.

Dylan Harper.note: Helped off holding his groin in the loss to Detroit; no diagnosis yet.

Nic Claxton.note: First return to Brooklyn since the June trade to Chicago.

LJ Cryer.note: New Orleans native; likely his first NBA game in his hometown, vs the Pelicans.

Jonathan Kuminga.note: Right shoulder contusion, no timetable; holds a $6.4M player option for 2027.

Mo Bamba.note: 26 points in his first Jazz start; admits the frustration but says the locker room isn't hopeless.

Bam Adebayo.note: Probable for Nov 18 after leaving with hip tightness; faces Herro for the first time since their July confrontation.

Lu Dort.note: First return to Oklahoma City since leaving the title team for Atlanta.

Aaron Wiggins.note: First return to Oklahoma City since leaving the title team for Atlanta.

Walker Kessler.note: Redick expects him back on Nov 18 vs Utah after a leg-soreness absence.

Jayson Tatum.note: Playing through a bruised hand; shot 9-of-23 in the loss at Orlando.

Julius Randle.note: Final year of his deal with Brooklyn after the June three-team trade; the Nets are listening to offers.

CJ McCollum.note: Strained left calf; re-evaluated in about four weeks.

Deni Avdija.note: Sore left foot; ruled out vs Minnesota, no timeline.
